Name: Accessible Locations
Author: Trojan073
Description:
Accessible Locations:  Adds 4(ish) new areas from event locations and cut content.


As you could tell by the earlier description, this mod adds the ability to go to several locations exclusive to events and one locations from some cut content.  As for the locations, it adds the following:

Haley's Darkroom
Maru's Basement
The Pit (From the Sam Concert Event)
Bus Interior (From the old, cut, introductory content)


In order to access the first 2 locations, the player has to reach 8 hearts with Haley and Maru respectively.  As for the Pit, all you need is to upgrade the Bus.  Lastly, for the Bus, just walk into the entrance.



If you have any suggestions for features or have found any bugs message me on discord:  Trojan073#9872

v1.1.0 Changes:
Added some locational messages and compatibility with [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12181]Renewed Bus[/url].


Mod requires Bus Locations and Content Patcher

As for compatibility, I am 90 percent sure it is compatible with SVE.
Currently adding compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12018]Maru new Basement[/url], I've talked to the mod author and edited their mod so it would work.
